Name: Idle Plus Walk
Author: ViolentFran
Description:
This mod modifies the game's NPC animation logic, allowing for the creation of [b]Character Mods [/b]with[b] Unique Idle Poses[/b].
It works by reserving frame 1 of the walk animation rows as a unique idle pose while using only frames 2-3-4 for the walk animation in a ping-pong playback style.

[size=4][b]Used in These Fine Character Mods:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]My very own Tall Wives Mods: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42110]Long Leah[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43238]Huge Haley[/url]﻿.
[*]Ash1307's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42811]Full Height Abigail - SCA - Nyapu style[/url]
[/list]If you are using IdlePlusWalk on your character mod and want to be featured here, send me a message.

[size=4][b]How to Use:[/b][/size]
Download both Idle Plus Walk and a character mod that uses it.

[b][size=4]How to make your own Character Mods with Idle Poses?[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Use the first frame of the walk animation rows as the idle pose.
[*]In your content patch mod add this CustomField to the modded character data: "violentfran.IdlePlusWalk/Use": "true"
[*]Here on Nexus, add Idle Plus Walk as a requirement to your character mod.
[/list]You can confirm your character mod is working with Idle Plus Walk through the SMAPI console. After loading for the first time into a save, a message like this will be printed:[i] "[Idle Plus Walk] Leah is using IdlePlusWalk."

Feel free to contact me if you need help implementing this framework into your character mod![/i]

[size=4][b]Known Issues:[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]It does not work for the preview in the character's profile.
[/list]
